description:
SAIC is building an early-career AI/ML Developer team within our Solutions and Technology Group, reporting to the Intel Space CTO. In this matrixed role, you will support the creation, prototyping, and operationalization of cutting-edge AI/ML Proof of Concepts (PoCs)—including GenAI/LLMs, NLP, and computer vision—specifically tailored to Intelligence Community (IC) mission use cases. These are dynamic, high-impact positions supporting multiple IC programs in both unclassified and classified environments. This is a hybrid role for candidates residing in the Northern Virginia corridor, with on-site work in SCIFs and customer facilities as needed.
 Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
 Rapid PoC & demo prototyping (≈50%): Assist senior developers in designing, coding, and deploying visual AI/ML prototypes (GenAI/LLMs, NLP, computer vision) to address IC mission needs.
 Environment setup: Help configure and maintain development environments and local tooling for both unclassified and SCIF-based AI development.
 Secure deployment & MLOps (≈30%): Collaborate with senior engineers to containerize applications (e.g., Docker) and package models for deployment into secure environments.
 Pipeline integration: Assist in integrating prototypes into CI/CD pipelines and deploying them into secure, multi-tenant cloud environments (AWS and/or Azure).
 Demos & stakeholder support (≈20%): Prepare prototype environments for customer demonstrations and ensure codebases are clean, well-structured, and well-commented.
 Documentation: Draft clear technical documentation, API guides, and system diagrams to support the transition of prototypes into operational systems.
 

 Residency in the Northern Virginia corridor with the ability to support a hybrid work model (remote plus on-site SCIF/customer locations as required).
 Active Top Secret clearance with the ability to obtain SCI access.
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline and 2+ years of relevant software or AI/ML experience.
 OR Master’s degree in a related technical discipline with 0+ years of relevant experience.
 Foundational proficiency in Python and core software engineering practices (e.g., Git-based version control, unit testing, clean code architectures).
 Hands-on exposure to at least one major ML framework (e.g., PyTorch or TensorFlow) through coursework, personal projects, internships, or professional tasks.
 Clearance Requirements: 
 Active Top Secret clearance with the ability to obtain SCI access.
 TS/SCI strongly preferred and may be required for specific program tasking.
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Familiarity with Docker and basic cloud concepts in AWS and/or Azure.
 Experience using lightweight frontend tools or frameworks (e.g., React) to build functional, interactive user interfaces for demonstrations.
 Familiarity with Intelligence Community missions, environments, and workflows.
 Physical Requirements: 
 Works primarily in an office, lab, or SCIF environment using computers and standard office equipment.
 Ability to sit or stand for extended periods while working at a computer workstation.
 May require occasional lifting of laptops and related equipment (up to ~20 lbs).
 Ability to commute to Northern Virginia-area SAIC and customer facilities and to travel occasionally to other customer sites as required by the program.
 
 SAIC®  is a premier mission integrator focused on advancing the power of technology and innovation to serve and protect our world. Our robust portfolio of offerings across the defense, space, intelligence, and civilian markets includes secure high-end solutions in mission IT, enterprise IT, engineering services, and professional services. We integrate emerging technology, rapidly and securely, into mission critical operations that modernize and enable critical national imperatives. 
 
 

 We are approximately 23,000 strong; driven by mission, united by purpose, and inspired by opportunities. SAIC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, SAIC has annual revenues of approximately $7.3 billion. For more information, visit  saic.com . For ongoing news, please visit our  newsroom .
